component.name: Dorion
component.summary: Alternative Discord client for lower-spec or storage-sensitive PCs

description.p: Dorion is an alternative Discord client aimed towards lower-spec or storage-sensitive PCs. It loads the web client in a webview, so it carries none of the bundled dependencies of the native client, and supports themes, plugins and more.

ul.li: Small install size and lower RAM/VRAM use than the native client
RPC (RS) integration, soundboard, tray controls and window state
Portable mode, deep links, and hotkeys
Custom injection, so it works alongside shelter and other client mods
